turns.question: What was our CPA on search in September 2026?
turns.answer: Search's CPA, which the semantic layer defines as cost per booking (its one definition of cost per conversion: ad spend over bookings), was 124.84 EUR per booking for 1-30 September 2026. Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
